description: Sections 1, 3, 4 (frontend, AWS-independent, non-transacting): rename the customer-facing nav group to 'Request' and add 'Zip' to it; create the public /zip page; add a 'Perks' nav group immediately above 'Legal Stuff' (Gift Cards, Rewards, Offers); create the public /perks page; and repair the /gift-card references by giving them a real public destination. All new pages reuse the shared shell (PageTopBand / RotatingHero, Header, Footer) and the three-list public-route registration. NO new transacting controls - any Buy/Redeem/Check-Balance/Book-Pickup/Rewards affordance that has no real backend is rendered as a clearly non-transacting 'coming soon'/disabled affordance that cannot transact; real existing routes (orders, submit-request, request-amendment, drop-docs, vault, leave-review) are linked where they genuinely answer the action.
steps: SECTION 1 - nav: In src/components/Header.tsx COLUMNS, change the group heading currently 'Requests' to 'Request' (the exact customer-facing label the user mandates; never 'Get Help'/'Customer-Service'/'Selfservice'/'Help Hub'). Do NOT touch internal `customerservice` identifiers, config/public-pages.json group id 'customerservice', workspace routes, provider templates, APIs, or historical integration ids.

SECTION 1 - add Zip row: In the same 'Request' group, add { label: 'Zip', href: '/zip/', match: '/zip' } positioned per the user's suggested order (Orders, Zip, Submit Request, Request Amendment, Drop Docs, Vault, Leave Review). Keep existing working routes unchanged.
Update src/components/Header.test.tsx to assert the 'Request' heading and the new 'Zip' row (and that no banned label appears). Keep all existing asserted rows.

SECTION 3 - /zip page: Create src/pages/zip.tsx as a thin page reusing the shared shell exactly like src/pages/cart.tsx reuses components/PageTopBand.tsx (or RotatingHero like orders.tsx - match whichever shared top component the sibling Request pages use; verify by reading those files). After the common top section render Zip-specific content with the user's heading 'Zip' and lead 'Track it. Arrange it. Keep it moving.' (or the stated alternative). Scoped styled-jsx with a zip- class prefix; reuse existing colours, typography, button and card treatments; preserve accessibility (single h1 from the shared band, section h2s) and SEO/meta/schema via the standard registration.

SECTION 3 - Zip actions, real-capability-gated: Surface ONLY actions backed by real existing destinations as working links: Track Order -> /orders/, Track Request / Amend Request -> /orders/ or /request-amendment/ (verify which real route answers each), Send Documents -> /drop-docs/, Open Vault -> /vault/, Leave Review -> /leave-review/. For 'Book a Visit', 'Prescription Pickup', 'Book Pickup / Shipment Pickup' and 'Check Delivery Status': FIRST verify (grep the repo) whether a real courier/pickup/delivery-tracking backend or provider exists. If it does NOT exist, do NOT create fake functionality or a working-looking booking button - render a clearly non-transacting 'coming soon'/disabled affordance (reuse components/ComingSoon.tsx if suitable) and record in findings exactly what real capability Zip surfaces vs what was left as non-transacting architecture.

SECTION 4 - Perks nav group: In src/components/Header.tsx COLUMNS, add a new group with heading 'Perks' positioned IMMEDIATELY ABOVE the 'Legal Stuff' group (same column), with links Gift Cards, Rewards, Offers. Decide the real hrefs: Gift Cards -> the repaired gift-card destination (see Section 4 gift-card step); Rewards and Offers -> sections/anchors on /perks/ (e.g. /perks/#rewards, /perks/#offers) or /perks/. Do NOT mention 'Gift Up'/'GiftUp'/any third-party provider name anywhere.

SECTION 4 - /perks page: Create src/pages/perks.tsx (thin, shared shell) with the user's Perks messaging: headline 'A little extra, made for you.' (or a stated alternative), a Gift Cards section ('Give them something they'll actually use.' + the stated supporting copy), an Offers section ('Something extra' + 'Explore available offers and apply eligible coupons during checkout.'), and a Rewards section ('More reasons to come back'). CTAs: Gift Cards may show Buy a Gift Card / Redeem Gift Card / Check Balance ONLY as non-transacting affordances unless a real backend is verified; Offers must display only real/current offers (if none are wired, state that honestly, no invented offers); Rewards must NOT invent points/balances/reward history/eligibility - only expose rewards after verifying a real current rewards backend exists, otherwise a clearly non-transacting 'coming soon'. If any section strictly needs legal wording, add a TODO comment only (do NOT write legal clauses; terms.ts/privacy.ts are out of scope).

SECTION 4 - /gift-card audit & repair: Decide the real public destination for gift cards (either a dedicated /gift-card route page, or /perks/gift-cards, or the Gift Cards section on /perks/). Create that real public page/section. Repoint the ACTIVE customer-facing /gift-card links to the real destination: in amplify/functions/messaging/inbound-whatsapp-handler/handler.py (the two https://wecare.digital/gift-card CTAs) and amplify/functions/ai/ai-generate-response/handler.py (store_gift_card CTA), and amplify/functions/operations/seo-tools/wix.py (the '/gift-card' SEO entry) IF a /gift-card route is kept vs moved. Do NOT break workspace DISPLAY references (src/pages/workspace/dashboard/system-architecture.tsx, workspace/engage/whatsapp/scripts.tsx) or Meta-approved historical ids; if the destination path changes, update the display strings for accuracy but do not rename ids. Record the full audit result (every reference found, what was changed, what was intentionally left) in findings.

REGISTRATION (all new routes): For /zip and /perks (and /gift-card or /perks/gift-cards if a distinct route): add each to PUBLIC_PAGE_META in src/pages/_app.tsx (name + description + type), add each to PUBLIC_EXACT in scripts/generate-sitemap.js, then run `node scripts/generate-public-pages.js` to regenerate config/public-pages.json and add a 'perks' entry to its hand-written groups[] array (id/title/note) and set the correct group on each new page. Verify `node scripts/generate-public-pages.js --check` passes.

Add vitest coverage: a Zip page test and a Perks page test (render, assert the mandated headings/copy, assert non-transacting affordances carry no live transact action, assert real-route links resolve to the expected hrefs), and extend/trust PublicRouteRegistration.test.ts / PublicAiSurface.test.ts to keep the three lists in step. Follow existing test patterns in src/test and src/components/__tests__.
Commit to feature/customer-experience-upgrade with explicit-path staging only.
acceptance_criteria: The customer-facing nav group reads 'Request' (never a banned label) and contains a working 'Zip' row; Header.test.tsx asserts this and passes.
A 'Perks' nav group appears immediately above 'Legal Stuff' with Gift Cards, Rewards, Offers links.
/zip and /perks render with the shared Header/Footer/top band and the mandated headings/copy; `npm run build` emits them and the sitemap count grows accordingly.

No fabricated transacting controls exist: Book Pickup/Check Balance/Rewards without a verified backend are clearly non-transacting affordances; real actions link to real existing routes (orders/request-amendment/drop-docs/vault/leave-review).
The /gift-card references resolve to a real public destination; active CTAs repointed; workspace display references and Meta ids not broken. Audit recorded in findings.
No third-party gift-card provider name appears in any customer-facing UI.
PublicRouteRegistration.test.ts, PublicAiSurface.test.ts, StructuredDataService.test.ts and `node scripts/generate-public-pages.js --check` all pass; terms.ts/privacy.ts unchanged.
Full gate stays green: pytest, tsc --noEmit, vitest, npm run build.
verification: npx vitest run (new /zip, /perks tests + registration guards pass)
npm run build (re-run once if the only failure is a transient blog 429; confirm /zip and /perks in output and sitemap)
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q (gift-card CTA repoint handlers still pass)
findings:
IMPLEMENTED Sections 1, 3, 4 (frontend + a few Python CTA string edits; no transacting controls, no AWS/live calls).

NAV (Section 1): src/components/Header.tsx COLUMNS - renamed the group heading 'Requests' -> 'Request' (the exact mandated label; no banned 'Get Help'/'Customer-Service'/'Selfservice'/'Help Hub'). Added { label:'Zip', href:'/zip/', match:'/zip' } directly after Orders, giving order Orders, Zip, Submit Request, Request Amendment, Drop Docs, Vault, Leave Review. Did NOT touch internal `customerservice` identifiers, config group id 'customerservice', workspace routes, provider templates, APIs or historical ids.

PERKS NAV (Section 4): added a new 'Perks' group immediately ABOVE 'Legal Stuff' in the same (third) column, with Gift Cards -> /perks/#gift-cards (match '/perks'), Rewards -> /perks/#rewards, Offers -> /perks/#offers. No third-party provider name anywhere.

/zip PAGE (Section 3): src/pages/zip.tsx, thin page reusing the shared shell via components/PageTopBand (fixed-statement band, same one /cart/ uses; RotatingHero not used because the heading is the fixed word 'Zip', not a rotating phrase). Heading 'Zip', lead 'Track it. Arrange it. Keep it moving.', section h2 'Everything about your request, delivery or pickup in one place'. REAL capabilities surfaced as working links: Track an order->/orders/, Track a request->/orders/ (orders.tsx tracks order/delivery/request/booking), Amend a request->/request-amendment/, Send documents->/drop-docs/, Open your vault->/vault/, Leave a review->/leave-review/. NON-TRANSACTING architecture (no backend exists - verified no courier/pickup/visit/delivery-tracking handler under amplify/functions): Book a visit, Prescription pickup, Book a pickup, Shipment pickup, Check delivery status are rendered as inert .zip-soon spans with aria-disabled, no href, not buttons, each tagged 'Coming soon'. Scoped styled-jsx with zip- prefix; chrome inherited from _app.tsx (not imported).

/perks PAGE (Section 4): src/pages/perks.tsx, thin page on PageTopBand. Headline 'A little extra, made for you.', sub 'Gifts, rewards and offers in one place.' Three sections with anchors: #gift-cards ('Give them something they'll actually use.' + 'Choose a WECARE.DIGITAL gift card and let them decide what comes next.'), #offers ('Something extra' + 'Explore available offers and apply eligible coupons during checkout.' + honest note that there are no live offers), #rewards ('More reasons to come back' + honest coming-soon, no invented points/balances/history/eligibility). Gift-card controls Buy a gift card / Redeem a gift card / Check balance are inert .pk-chip spans with aria-disabled (no backend; cart_v2 still rejects gift-card payment). No provider name. A TODO comment marks where gift-card terms would link later; terms.ts/privacy.ts untouched.

GIFT-CARD AUDIT (every reference, decision = Gift Cards section of /perks/ reached at /perks/#gift-cards; CTAs point at https://wecare.digital/perks/; no distinct /gift-card route created):
  - amplify/functions/messaging/inbound-whatsapp-handler/handler.py line ~2041 ('gift' keyword CTA): 'https://wecare.digital/gift-card' -> 'https://wecare.digital/perks/'. CHANGED.
  - same file line ~6805 ('_cta_gift_card' action, 'View Gift Cards'): same repoint. CHANGED (body_text/footer unchanged; Meta-approved button text 'View Gift Cards' left as-is).
  - amplify/functions/ai/ai-generate-response/handler.py line ~420 (store_gift_card CTA 'Get Gift Card'): URL repointed to '/perks/'. CHANGED (CTA label and text left as-is).
  - amplify/functions/operations/seo-tools/wix.py line ~119 (SITE_PAGES Wix SEO registry entry ('/gift-card','eGift Card','service')): -> ('/perks','Perks','service'). CHANGED (this is a legacy Wix storefront page registry, full of Wix-only paths; relabelled for accuracy, no tests reference it).
  - Workspace DISPLAY references in src/pages/workspace/dashboard/system-architecture.tsx and workspace/engage/whatsapp/scripts.tsx: grep for 'gift' in src/**/*.tsx and src/pages/workspace/** returned NO matches, so there was nothing to update or break; no Meta-approved id renamed.
  - After change, repo-wide grep for 'gift-card' in **/*.py = 0 matches.

REGISTRATION (three lists + generated catalog): added '/zip' and '/perks' to PUBLIC_PAGE_META in src/pages/_app.tsx (name/type WebPage/description), to PUBLIC_EXACT in scripts/generate-sitemap.js, added STRUCTURAL entries in scripts/generate-public-pages.js ('/zip' group 'start' as a hub beside Orders, '/perks' group 'perks'), added the hand-written 'perks' group to config/public-pages.json groups[] (above legal), and regenerated config/public-pages.json (26 pages). `node scripts/generate-public-pages.js --check` passes. Added /zip and /perks StructuredData classification to NOT_OFFERINGS in src/test/StructuredDataService.test.ts (neither is an offering).

TESTS: new src/test/ZipPage.test.tsx (5) and src/test/PerksPage.test.tsx (8, incl. the gift-card repoint audit asserted against the handler source). Extended src/components/__tests__/Header.test.tsx for the 'Request' heading, banned-label absence, the Zip row + order + active state, and the Perks group position above Legal Stuff + hrefs + no provider name.

POST-CHANGE GATE COUNTS (branch feature/customer-experience-upgrade): vitest 714 passed / 52 files (was 698/50); node scripts/generate-public-pages.js --check exit 0 (26 pages); tsc --noEmit exit 0; npm run build exit 0 after one re-run (first run failed only on the documented transient blog 429 at /post/principles-fundamentals-that-orient-action), sitemap 1409 URLs (was 1407, +2 for /zip and /perks), both out/zip/index.html (45KB) and out/perks/index.html (42KB) emitted as real pages (not the ~144KB staff shell) and present in sitemap.xml; pytest 6001 passed / 1 skipped (unchanged baseline). Verified out/perks carries id="gift-cards" and no 'Gift Up'/'GiftUp' string.
